card.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
card.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The wedding venue has made a small change.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The date remains available. The building does not.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fire. Let's hold onto the available date while we choose what comes next.
